ownership.fallback: consumer-supplied command-substring predicate; migrated entries must keep their legacy substring so not-yet-migrated tools still recognize their own entries

conventions.mergePolicy: owner-scoped strip-then-append: remove only entries owned by the caller, append fresh ones, preserve every foreign byte; whole-file overwrite is allowed only for tool-owned files

pathPlaceholders.{id}: rule or file id chosen by the consumer

conventions.scopeResolution: project paths resolve against the repository root; user paths against the home directory unless an envOverrides key is set

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.notes: Marketplace install delivers skills and bundled hooks together; plugin.json may carry "skills" and "hooks" fields.

codex.name: Codex CLI
codex.notes: Hooks are enabled by default; the first run may show a trust prompt for project hooks. Matcher vocabulary is product policy, not registry data. Known shared-file site: two family tools write this file - use ownership sidecar.

opencode.name: OpenCode

plugin.dualApi: default export {id, server, setup}: server() serves 1.18.29+ (v1 tool.execute.before, throw-to-reject), setup() serves 2.x (ctx.tool.hook("execute.before"), the only V2 hook that may reject); keep the legacy named export for older 1.x stubs
plugin.stubConvention: export { default } from "<absolute path to plugin module>"; OpenCode labels local plugins by stub file name

opencode.notes: No hook-config file: integration is a plugin module plus a one-line re-export stub.

gemini.name: Gemini CLI
gemini.notes: Timeout unit differs from Claude-dialect harnesses (ms, not s). Family policy split observed: dejavu auto-merges user scope, stop-ai-slop prints snippets only - the kit default is print-only for user scope.

qwen.name: Qwen Code
qwen.notes: Gemini CLI fork but event naming observed as PreToolUse (not BeforeTool) in stop-ai-slop snippets - verify empirically before auto-writing; settings.json is user-global, print-only by default.

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.notes: Entries are flat {command, timeout} - no type field, unlike the Claude dialect.

cline.name: Cline

plugin.inProcess: long-lived sandbox subprocess host (see dejavu src/cline-plugin.ts); declared via package.json "cline.plugins"

cline.notes: Root plugin.json points its hooks field at a Claude-dialect bundle file - a dialect reuse that must stay documented.

kiro.name: Kiro
kiro.notes: Top-level hooks is an ARRAY of {name, trigger, matcher, action:{type,command}, timeout}; informational output rides raw stdout.

devin.name: Devin CLI
devin.notes: Event keys sit at the config root (no hooks wrapper). Auto-imports .claude/settings.json hooks (read_config_from.claude), so a Claude install already gates Devin sessions. Known shared-file site: two family tools wrote this file with different identity substrings - the reason ownership moved to a sidecar.

copilot.name: VS Code Copilot (local hooks)
copilot.notes: Preview feature: tool names are not a stable API - gate payloads by shape (file_path+content / old+new_string / edits[] / V4A patch text), never by name. Per-tool file ownership makes overwrite safe here.

crush.name: Crush
crush.notes: No AfterTool hook exists - failure observation is degraded (pre-tool only). Entries are flat {matcher, command}.

git.name: git (pre-commit enforcement surface)

markers.mode: append-or-replace, never clobber a foreign hook

git.notes: Not an AI harness; included because the marker-block primitive and install UX are shared with harness wiring.
